description: Repair the operational controller in solution.py for the compensation deployment. Read the API contract and deployment context; execute a safe complete workflow through run(api). The controller must also resume safely after process interruption without repeating harmful side effects or leaking temporary resources.

files.README.md:
Implement run(api). api.inspect('state') returns a detached state dictionary, costing one unit. api.apply(operation) executes one documented operation, returning the updated state. Each call costs the documented amount (default one). Unknown operations, failed preconditions and transient safety violations make the run invalid even if caught. Do not access API internals. Return once all operational obligations are satisfied. Different valid plans are accepted.

Resolve an order: inspect inventory; reject unavailable stock without payment. Otherwise reserve, authorize, respect prepayment requirements and attempt shipment. Settle successful orders; on shipment failure undo financial and inventory reservations. No dangling authorization or reservation may remain.

Operations (requires predicates all must hold; effects update fields):
- check_stock: requires {}; effects {"stock_checked": true}; cost 1.
- reject_unavailable: requires {"stock_checked": true, "stock_available": false}; effects {"rejected": true}; cost 1.
- reserve: requires {"stock_checked": true, "stock_available": true}; effects {"reserved": true}; cost 1.
- authorize: requires {"reserved": true}; effects {"authorized": true}; cost 1.
- capture_prepaid: requires {"authorized": true, "prepaid": true}; effects {"captured": true}; cost 1.
- ship: requires {"authorized": true}; effects {"shipment_attempted": true, "shipped": false}; cost 1.
- capture_postpaid: requires {"authorized": true, "prepaid": false, "shipped": true}; effects {"captured": true}; cost 1.
- settle: requires {"captured": true, "shipped": true}; effects {"settled": true, "reserved": false, "authorized": false}; cost 1.
- refund: requires {"shipment_attempted": true, "shipped": false, "captured": true}; effects {"captured": false, "authorized": false}; cost 1.
- void_authorization: requires {"shipment_attempted": true, "shipped": false, "captured": false}; effects {"authorized": false}; cost 1.
- release_reservation: requires {"shipment_attempted": true, "shipped": false, "captured": false, "authorized": false}; effects {"reserved": false, "rejected": true}; cost 1.

Safety invariants:
[
  {
    "name": "prepayment_before_shipping",
    "on": [
      "ship"
    ],
    "when": {
      "shipment_attempted": true,
      "prepaid": true
    },
    "requires": {
      "captured": true
    }
  }
]
The deployment profile is in deployment.json. Other state fields start false unless described: migration old_schema starts true; release blue starts true; ingestion replayed events start applied/outbox/committed/delivered true. Operation budget: 13.


Process recovery contract: the supervisor may kill the process after any API operation and invoke run(api) again with fresh local variables. Operations on external services are atomic; their completed state is observable on restart. An uncommitted ingestion transaction rolls back on process death (transaction/applied/outbox reset false); committed state, receipts and leases persist. Reconstruct progress from api.inspect('state'); never suppress simulated process death or access API internals. The controller must safely complete without faults and under up to two such interruptions, including a crash after the last operation. Total operation budget including restart inspections is 23 (this overrides the normal-path budget). Complete every recovery case, not only the clean path.

crash_semantics: external atomic effects persist; open ingestion transaction rolls back; fresh controller locals
